Roofing services

Every kind of roof, one firm.

Over 25 years on Yorkshire roofs, from a leaking gutter joint or a slipped slate to a full roof replacement. Domestic and commercial repair and re-roof work, from a single tile to a whole new roof. Ask for a free quotation: A & L will try to beat any genuine like-for-like quote.

  1. Flat roofs

    Felt and GRP fibreglass flat roofing. The felt system is a two-layer SBS torch-on membrane, in a mineral finish of green, charcoal or red. Every flat re-roof comes with a 20 year guarantee.

  2. Lead, stone and chimneys

    Lead work, Yorkshire stone roofs (new, turned and repaired), brick and stone pointing, and chimney stack removal.

  3. Tiled roofs

    Concrete or clay tiles. Concrete tiles from Marley, Sandtoft, Redland and Monier, from double pantile to plain tile, with dry ridge, verge and valley systems for roofs that need little upkeep.

  4. Slate roofs

    Man-made or natural slate, fitted to new roofs and re-roofs. Welsh and Spanish natural slate, and fibre-cement and resin-bonded man-made slate from Marley Eternit, Redland and Sandtoft. Their current site shows a man-made slate project for Mears Group PLC.

Repairs

general roof repairs, from a slipped slate to a missing tile; leaking gutter joints; insurance work undertaken; roof surveys

Roofline and drainage

guttering in UPVC or timber; gutter cleaning; PVC fascias and soffits

Extras

Velux window supply and installation; dormer roofs; door canopies; non-licensed asbestos removal

In A & L’s own words

How a roofing job runs.

  1. 01

    Survey

    A & L surveys the property first, then agrees dates with you and sticks to them as far as they possibly can.

  2. 02

    Start date

    They can generally give a start date within one to two weeks, depending on the project. The weather is the main uncertainty.

  3. 03

    The work

    Your roof is protected at all times once work has started. Skips and scaffolding are included in the price where the project needs them.

  4. 04

    Guarantee

    Guarantees vary with the project. A full re-roof is generally 20 years.

Qualified, insured, trained.

A small family run business. All the work is carried out by fully qualified tradesmen with NVQ 1, 2 and 3, City and Guilds and Health and Safety training.

  • Family run, with over 25 years of experience
  • Fully registered and insured
  • Free quotations, and they will try to beat any genuine like-for-like quote
  • Skips and scaffolds included in the price where a project needs them
